name: Read book price (incl. tax) and stock availability
description: Navigates the online book catalogue to a given category, opens a specific book's product detail page, and reads the authoritative Product Information rows: the tax-inclusive price and the availability line that includes the number of copies in stock. Reach for this when an agent needs precise pricing or inventory figures for a named title rather than the abbreviated summary shown on listing pages.

inputs.name: categoryName
inputs.description: Sidebar catalogue category to filter to before locating the title, e.g. 'Science'.

inputs.name: bookTitle
inputs.description: Exact title of the book whose product detail page should be opened within the chosen category listing.

outputs.name: priceInclTax
outputs.description: Tax-inclusive price of the book taken from the 'Price (incl. tax)' row of the Product Information table.

outputs.name: availability
outputs.description: Availability text from the Product Information table, including the number of copies in stock, e.g. 'In stock (5 available)'.

steps.rationale: The goal specifies the book is in the Science category; the sidebar category link filters the catalogue to Science titles.
Title link for 'The Grand Design' within the Science listing — opens the product detail page which carries the tax-inclusive price and stock count.

checkpoint.description: Navigated Home → Science category → 'The Grand Design' product page and read its Product Information table. Price (incl. tax) is £13.76 (tax £0.00, so equal to the excl. tax price) and availability is 'In stock (5 available)'. Both values were recorded via row-label anchors ('Price (incl. tax)' and 'Availability'), so replay can relocate them even if the amounts or counts change. Checkpoint is the stable 'Product Information' heading on the detail page.

provenance.goal: Open the book 'The Grand Design' from the Science category and read its price including tax and how many copies are in stock
warnings: step 2 (click): not unique — disambiguated by ordinal 0 of 2 matching link nodes
